_comment: Copy to .cursor/hooks.json in the consumer repo. Pairs with .agents/hooks/validate-on-edit.sh (see ../SKILL.md).
_comment_event: Event name `afterFileEdit` is pinned from Cursor's hook docs. If Cursor renames it, change this field only — the script is unaffected.
_comment_protocol: Cursor reads a JSON envelope on exit 0, not stderr on exit 2. VALIDATE_HOST forces that shape instead of relying on payload sniffing.
